newsitem.title: LIBYA: Salim says likely to seek new term as OAU chief.
newsitem.headline: Salim says likely to seek new term as OAU chief.

text.p: Salim Ahmed Salim said on Friday he would probably seek a new four-year term as secretary-general of the Organisation of African Unity at the next African summit in June.
"Most likely yes, if I get the necessary support," Salim said when asked whether he would seek a new mandate at the OAU's annual summit due to be held in Harare on June 2-4.
Salim, 55, was speaking at a news conference at the end of a three-day African foreign ministers' meeting in Tripoli.
The Tanzanian diplomat was first elected as secretary-general of the OAU in 1989 and was unanimously re-elected in 1993.
